title: Repairing Broken Access Control in Web Applications with LLMs: An Empirical Benchmark Study
abstract: arXiv:2610.34290v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Broken access control (BAC) ranks among the most severe web-application vulnerability classes, yet its automated repair remains largely unexplored. Unlike memory-safety vulnerabilities, BAC is a logic vulnerability whose repair demands a deep understanding of an application's access-control model and business semantics, which traditional automated vulnerability repair techniques handle poorly. Large language models (LLMs) open a promising avenue for this problem, but no standard benchmark exists for studying how well they repair BAC vulnerabilities. We construct BAC-Bench, the first benchmark for BAC repair, consisting of 46 real-world BAC vulnerabilities drawn from six widely used web applications spanning four programming languages. Each vulnerability is equipped with a sandboxed runtime environment, a PoC validation program and a functional test program. translated_title: 使用大语言模型修复Web应用程序中的失效访问控制：一项实证基准研究
translated_abstract: 失效访问控制是最严重的Web应用程序漏洞类别之一，但其自动化修复在很大程度上仍未被探索。与内存安全漏洞不同，失效访问控制是一种逻辑漏洞，其修复需要对应用程序的访问控制模型和业务语义有深入的理解，而传统的自动化漏洞修复技术对此处理不佳。大语言模型为这一问题开辟了一条有前景的途径，但目前尚无标准基准来研究其修复失效访问控制漏洞的能力。我们构建了BAC-Bench，这是首个用于失效访问控制修复的基准，包含46个来自六个广泛使用的Web应用程序的真实失效访问控制漏洞，涵盖四种编程语言。每个漏洞都配备了一个沙盒化的运行环境、一个PoC验证程序和一个功能测试程序。我们进一步提出了一个失效访问控制修复策略框架，对任何失效访问控制漏洞的特征进行刻画。
tldr: 该研究构建了首个用于修复Web应用失效访问控制漏洞的基准BAC-Bench，包含来自六个真实Web应用的46个漏洞，并提出了相应的修复策略框架，为评估大语言模型修复此类逻辑漏洞的能力提供了标准化平台。
en_tdlr: This study introduces BAC-Bench, the first benchmark for repairing broken access control vulnerabilities in web applications—comprising 46 real-world vulnerabilities from six applications across four programming languages—along with a repair-strategy framework for evaluating LLM-based automated repair capabilities.
